narrative.northStar: The Category Standard, at Full Craft
narrative.overview:
Khan Academy's calm and math legibility, Brilliant's polished feedback, Linear/Notion type and spacing discipline, and Duolingo's decisive Check structure without its playful styling, worn in the teacher's own identity. White ground, one ice-blue off-white surface, navy-black ink, and one accent: the teacher's Navy in light, his Baby Blue in dark. The AE mark signs the shell. The question and its feedback own the screen; chrome stays quiet.

Density is relaxed and phone-first: 48px touch targets, 56px choice rows, a 680-720px content column on desktop. Depth comes from 1px lines and tonal surfaces, with soft shadows reserved for surfaces that act (primary button, sheets, dialogs, the feedback dock). Motion is short and purposeful, and every animation collapses to its end state under reduced motion. Light and dark themes share the same roles; every screen ships in both.

The public landing page (`apps/landing/`) speaks the same palette louder: navy bands, a serif display voice and graph-paper rules. Its additions are scoped to it in **Landing page** below and do not enter the app.

Confirmed rejections (from the approved spec): cold grey SaaS, gamified chrome (points, mascots, confetti), exam-software imitation (Bluebook), clutter at 360px.
keyCharacteristics: One brand colour (Navy in light, Baby Blue in dark) for selection and primary action; green and coral only for verdicts.
Status is always icon + word, never colour alone.
Lexend everywhere in the app, tabular numerals for counts, timers and scores; LaTeX via `flutter_math_fork` at 1.21x the surrounding text.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px lines; shadows only on acting surfaces.
The AE `BrandMark` is the only logo, beside the name in the shell header and on the auth screens.
Lucide icons through one semantic `AppIcons` map.
unDraw illustrations recoloured to the brand at runtime, never inside the question area.

rules.name: The One Brand Colour Rule
rules.body: In the app, `brand` (Navy, or Baby Blue in dark) means "act here" or "you chose this". Don't use it for decoration, headings or status.

rules.name: The Icon-And-Word Rule
rules.body: Every status (correct, incorrect, warning, offline, locked, saved) shows a Lucide icon and a word. Colour reinforces the meaning; it never carries it alone.

rules.name: The Teacher's Voice Rule
rules.body: Warm fill and warm ink are the teacher's voice only. They never mark a verdict. (The warning banner borrows `warm-line` for its border; that is the one shared use.)

rules.name: The Hue Is Identity Rule
rules.body: Subject hues identify units and topics. They never signal progress, mastery or correctness.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes in place (counts, timers, scores, topic numbers) uses `AppType.count`, `AppType.timer` or `FontFeature.tabularFigures()`.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case. The system has no uppercase or tracked-caps style.

rules.name: The Acting Surface Rule
rules.body: Only surfaces that ask for action get a shadow: the primary button, the verdict dock, the save bar, dialogs and sheets. Cards, tiles, chips and nav stay flat.

rules.name: The Navy Band Rule
rules.body: Full-bleed navy carries the hero, the method path and the closing band; every other section is white or Ice White. Text on navy is white, with `landing-on-navy-secondary` for supporting copy and Baby Blue for strokes, the slogan and the primary button. On the landing page, Navy is the ground and the heading ink; the app's One Brand Colour Rule does not apply here.

rules.name: The Graph-Paper Rule
rules.body: Faint graph rules on a 48px square grid lie on the navy bands (Baby Blue at 7%) and on the Ice White tint sections (navy at 3.5%). The hero adds coordinate axes and a Baby Blue integral curve that draws once on load. The grid is ground texture; it never carries content.

rules.name: The Hairline Column Rule
rules.body: Lists and columns are divided by 1px `line` rules, not boxed in cards: the highlights ledger (vertical rules between four columns), the why and features lists (top rules), the credentials block, and the two courses (a 2px navy top rule and a vertical hairline between them). The sample question is the one bordered card.

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: The AE mark appears only as supplied: `logo-mark-reverse.svg` on navy (nav, 53px wide) and `logo-mark.svg` on white (footer, 46px wide), each beside the Domine name. The integral alone (`integral.svg`, Steel) serves as the pull-quote mark. `icon.svg` is the favicon, and the app icons are rendered from `icon.svg` and `icon-maskable.svg`.

dos: **Do** read colours from `context.appColors` and spacing, radius and sizes from `AppSpace` / `AppRadius` / `AppSize`. Check every new screen in light and dark at 360px and 1280px.
**Do** pair every status with a Lucide icon and a word, and put verdicts and errors in a `Semantics(liveRegion: true)`.
**Do** route every animation through `AppMotion.resolve` so it collapses to its end state when animations are disabled.
**Do** render questions only through the shared `QuestionView`, and math only through `MathText` (`flutter_math_fork`).
**Do** use tabular figures for any changing number.
**Do** keep UI copy English and sentence case, and set `TextDirection.ltr` on content text.
**Do** keep targets at least 48px and give choices, SPR fields and keypad keys 56px.
**Do** show the logo only through `BrandMark`, and spell the name "Abdelrahman Elmenshawy".
donts: **Don't** show status by colour alone, or use subject hues or warm fill for status.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, chips, tiles or nav. Shadows belong to acting surfaces only.
**Don't** use `brand` for decoration or headings in the app, or `danger` to judge an answer.
**Don't** add Material `Icons.*`, emoji or text glyphs as icons.
**Don't** add gamified chrome (points, mascots, confetti) or exam-software imitation.
**Don't** add uppercase kickers or eyebrow labels. The skill line above the stem is QuestionView anatomy, not a pattern for other titles.
**Don't** place illustrations inside the question or answer area.
**Don't** redraw, recolour or add "Certified" or "IGCSE" to the AE mark.
